name: hover-border-gradient

frames.best_why: Blue hover highlight wraps most of the rim while the label stays fully readable.

tagline: Soft glow travels around the rim of a black pill CTA.
summary: A rounded call-to-action button wrapped in a blurred gradient border. The glow creeps around the edge on a timer and washes blue when hovered.
appearance: A black pill button holding a small white chevron and the label, wrapped in a soft glowing rim. The rim is brightest at one segment and fades around the rest, and turns blue across most of its length on hover.
behaviour: At rest the brightest part of the rim steps from side to side every second, chasing around the pill. Hovering blends the whole rim into a blue highlight, then the slow white sweep resumes when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: The words 'Aceternity UI' beside a small chevron logo.
search_phrases: border light that circles on hover
black cta with moving edge light
button with light chasing around it
use_when: A dark page needs one hero call to action that draws the eye with a moving rim of light.
avoid_when: The glow is faint against black and the body is hardcoded black, so it does not suit light themes.
customise: Pick the rendered element with as, set sweep speed with duration and its direction with clockwise, and restyle inside and rim with className and containerClassName. The highlight blue is fixed.
weight_why: One animated gradient layer with a blur; negligible DOM.

a11y.note: The travelling glow is decorative but runs on a timer and ignores reduced-motion; focusing the button does not light the rim.

issues: The rim glow is faint against black and the body is always black.
Focusing the button does not trigger the border light.
polish_why: Neat travelling rim and clean pill shape; the glow is faint and the interior is always black.
title: Hover Border Gradient
